task_set.description: Repo-map retrieval tasks, v2. Each task has a style (symptom or identifier), an area, expected files, and the evidence commands and matches recorded while curating. The task text never names an expected file.
task_set.ground_truth_policy: Expected files were chosen by reading the code that does the work. Each evidence entry is the verbatim output of the recorded rg command at the base commit a6df57f0. The harness never derives expected files.

arm_descriptions.baseline: Plain source-file listing, sorted by path, truncated to budget.
arm_descriptions.dev_context: DevMemory.context items/snippets, executed at the budget.
arm_descriptions.dev_repo_map: Ranked repo map, executed at the budget.
arm_descriptions.both: Union of the dev_context and dev_repo_map file sets.
arm_descriptions.grep: Lexical baseline: files ranked by distinct task terms found in their text, then total occurrences, then path.
arm_descriptions.code_search: scripts.ocelot_code_search.code_search results, rendered as path:line: snippet in result order, truncated to budget.

A listing-tier hit tells the reader the path exists, not what it contains. - Token estimates are each module's own ~4-chars/token heuristic. Cache counts apply only to repo-map arms. - `both` is the literal union of the two retrievers run at the same budget; its token cost and latency are the sum of the components, so its budget is per component (up to 2x the nominal budget). Compare it as a cost/recall trade-off, not as an equal-token arm. - `code_search` runs once per task; its elapsed time is the same call's time at every budget. - Ground truth is frozen in the task JSON.
